fusions.name: Stamping Herd
fusions.desc: Stamps down, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them 2.5 tiles back. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 40%, and you heal for 12% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Four Stomachs
fusions.desc: A hooking gore that deals 8 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds and heals you for 15% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Chewing the Cud
fusions.desc: Restores 2 health a second to you for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Grass-Fed Bulk
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
